prompt:
Hand-drawn editorial illustration in exactly the style of the reference image: the same scruffy dog, the same loose, confident brush-pen ink line of one even weight, slightly wobbly organic strokes, a few flat solid fill shapes, no shading, no gradients, no texture, no text, no ground shadow. Exactly the same palette: line work in deep clover green-black #14301F, flat fills in tennis-ball felt chartreuse #D9EE52, the dog body white. Fully transparent background, the subject isolated with generous empty margin.

Subject: the same scruffy mixed-breed dog curled up asleep on a round flat cushion seen slightly from the side. The cushion is a flat chartreuse fill. Head resting on its front paws, eyes closed, ears draped, tail curled around. Calm and content. Two tiny curved breathing marks above it. Wide landscape composition, centred.
